//workspace: llmlint: ignore-block[projects_stay_in_one_js_workspace] this directory sits inside the dag-ui-e2e workspace member and resolves through that member's manifest and the one root bun.lock, as its sibling apps/dag-ui-e2e/load does; a manifest of its own adds a second member, which moved other projects' hashes in github-workflows-nx-cache's real-Nx fixtures and widened every change's selection through the root manifest.
name: dag-ui-read-latency
//compile: llmlint: ignore-block[new_projects_keep_the_graph_uniform] this target stays apart from `build`: a `build` target would put a release compile no other task reads in every `build` sweep, and folding it into `test` holds every other task off for the compile under parallelism:false, which ran test-linux into its 36-minute cap.

compile-release-server.//: A target of its own so the compile overlaps the job's other tasks: only the timed journey in `test` holds them off. Named apart from `build` so no build sweep compiles a server nothing else reads. It is the release's own Linux build, made into the target directory `wheel-smoke` and the release rehearsal share (scripts/build-linux-wheel.sh), so it times the binary that ships and compiles nothing they do not. Both depend on this target, so one compile runs and neither sleeps on that directory's lock holding an Nx slot (docs/linux-cold-cache-timing.md).

manifest-inputs-for-affected.//: Carries only file-based affected edges for semantic manifest inputs; CI never runs this uncached no-op.

test.//: Fresh timings on a release build, with nothing beside them and its telemetry what `budgets` reads, so never cached: apiServerSurface is among its inputs because that is what it measures. Writes through the real CLI, so it provisions the sibling.
test.//api-server: llmlint: ignore-block[expensive_tests_stay_behind_their_own_edge] the plan names `build-api-server` among this project's dependencies, the same edge `dag-ui-e2e:test` holds: in the tier that selects this project that task is already running for the browser journeys, so it costs nothing it would not, and it keeps the debug server current for anyone driving this journey's world by hand.

budgets.//: Telemetry-only: the budgets read what `test` just recorded and measure nothing themselves.

lint.command: node node_modules/@biomejs/biome/bin/biome check apps/dag-ui-e2e/read-latency && npx eslint --max-warnings 0 apps/dag-ui-e2e/read-latency

check.//: The default check plus budgets, so test-linux's tier reaches both by target name.
